items.title: ChatGPT Wallet lets OpenAI’s Dots agents make purchases for you
items.excerpt: OpenAI launched ChatGPT Wallet, letting its Dots agents complete purchases on a user's behalf with a check-in before every buy; rollout starts with US Pro subscribers. Agentic checkout moves inside ChatGPT ahead of Black Friday.

items.title: Google AI Mode gains local retailer ads after Search growth slows to 12%
items.excerpt: Four sponsored placements appeared in one AI Mode answer for retail shoppers, two weeks after Google said AI Mode earns less. Can more ads lift Q4 Search sales?

items.title: AI agent traffic is now a two-company town: Meta and OpenAI
items.excerpt: Muse sent 59% of October's agent requests and Comet just 3.6%, with 85% landing on product and search pages. Will Black Friday turn these agents into shoppers?

items.title: 74% of marketers can't track if AI agent leads become sales, Invoca finds
items.excerpt: Just 19% of US B2C marketers running AI agents send outcomes back to ad platforms, a survey of 451 shows. What are bidding systems learning from those chats?

items.title: IAB Releases AI-Era Attribution Blueprint, Giving the Industry a Shared Way to Account for AI’s Role in Purchases
items.excerpt: IAB released an AI-Era Attribution Blueprint defining how advertisers and platforms should measure AI's role when an assistant influences or completes a purchase, and how to evaluate attribution claims. Data it cites shows only 8.8% of visits after an AI brand mention come from the AI itself.

items.title: AI Creative In The Programmatic Loop
items.excerpt: The latest bolt-on to a DSP isn’t solving for media or measurement – it’s AI-generated creative. Inside the Viant-Waymark acquisition. Plus: CEO Jeff Green said The Trade Desk is open to M&A. So what kind of company could The Trade Desk buy?

items.title: Custom Ad Algorithms Are Helping Schibsted Win Budgets Back From Meta
items.excerpt: Schibsted is working with Nodals AI to create custom ad optimization algorithms and court brands who’ve been wooed by Meta’s own optimization tools.

items.title: AI is turning ad tech into a fight for the brain behind the buy
items.excerpt: AI is changing ad tech on two fronts: how marketing technology selects and delivers ads, and how consumers discover and buy products.

items.title: Mars wants to future proof impulse buys as AI is poised to take over more grocery runs
items.excerpt: Mars is preparing for AI-powered grocery shopping, from LLM visibility and retail partnerships to the future of impulse buys.

items.title: AI-derived audience insights hurt results: What the numbers say
items.excerpt: Over 80% of industry leaders have experienced at least one negative business outcome due to inaccurate AI outputs, per a recent report.

items.title: New Data: Holiday Shoppers Will Rely on Agents. Retailers Must Be Ready.
items.excerpt: A Salesforce survey shows that holiday shoppers are using AI agents for research and advice — almost 20% of shoppers now say that AI is their first stop on the way to the store — but most aren’t ready to let AI click Buy Now.

items.title: OpenAI ChatGPT Ads Updates With Intelligent Bidding, New Cost Targets, Geo-Flexibility & Product Set Filters
items.excerpt: OpenAI just sent out its weekly ChatGPT Ads update email announcing a number of updates including intelligent bidding, new cost targets in Ads Manager, more geographic flexibility for product feed campaigns and more flexible product set filters.

items.title: [컨콜] 네이버 "AI 광고, 클릭률 11%·전환수 9% 개선"
items.excerpt: 네이버가 AI 예측 모델을 광고 상품에 적용한 결과 파워링크 클릭률이 11%, 전환수가 9% 개선됐다고 3분기 컨퍼런스콜에서 밝혔다. 연내 구매·예약을 돕는 개인형 AI 에이전트 앱을 내놓고 광고 과금 방식도 바꾼다고 예고했다.

items.title: 버즈빌, 이용자별 광고 소재 자동 제작하는 초개인화 AI 엔진 ‘프리즘’ 출시
items.excerpt: 버즈빌이 이용자의 관심사와 구매 단계에 따라 서로 다른 광고를 보여주는 인공지능(AI) 광고 엔진을 선보였다. 같은 브랜드의 동일한 광고 캠페인에서도 이용자별로 상품 추천과 광고 메시지, 참여 방식을 다르게 구성하는 것이 특징이다.

items.title: "AI가 멋대로 결제·예약 못하게"…KISDI, 이용자 보호 안내서 추진
items.excerpt: (서울=뉴스1) 신민경 기자 = 인공지능(AI) 에이전트에 맡긴 업무를 이용자가 중단하거나 부여한 권한을 철회할 수 있도록 하는 이용자 보호 안내서 마련이 추진된다.

items.title: CJ올리브영, 모바일 앱에 AI 쇼핑 어시스턴트 '올영 티키' 도입
items.excerpt: 대화형 검색·추천 서비스…내달 정식 출시 예정 CJ올리브영(340460)은 모바일 앱에 생성형 인공지능(AI) 쇼핑 어시스턴트 '올영 티키'를 시범 운영한다고 11일 밝혔다.올영 티키는 AI가 고객의 질문 의 …

items.title: "AI가 고르는 쇼핑 시대"…카페24, 내년 자사몰 성장 전략 제시
items.excerpt: 12월 10일 코엑스서 '익스팬드 2027'…내년 커머스 전망 공유 운영·마케팅·물류 등 9개 상담 부스…사업 단계별 실행 방안 안내 인공지능(AI)이 상품을 찾고 비교하는 방식을 바꾸면서 온라인 사업자의 성장 전략도 재설계되고 있다. 고객을 쇼핑몰로 유입시키는 데 그치지 않고 브랜드
